reason: Both methods perform identical operations: they initialize min to the first element of the array and then iterate from index 0 up to (but not including) the given size/count, updating min when a smaller value is found. For any valid input (non‑null array with length >= size/count), both methods return the same minimum value. Edge cases such as null arrays or size/count larger than the array length result in the same ArrayIndexOutOfBoundsException in both methods. Therefore no concrete input can distinguish their behavior.
